name: IWF Television Tag Team Championship
epitaph: The record holds 3 reigns, from Brain Busters in November 1996 to Assault & Battery in 1997.

name: IWF Universal Championship
epitaph: Held by American Ninja as of 12 December 1996; the same broadcast previews Amish Warrior chasing the title away from him.

name: IWF United States Championship
epitaph: Held by Amish Warrior as of 12 December 1996, previewed defending it against Sonar that Sunday.

name: IWF Universal Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by the Soul Takers as of 12 December 1996, previewed defending it against Death & Destruction that Sunday.

name: IWF Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Butterball as of 13 February 1997, filling the vacancy the fed's own December 1996 broadcast had announced pending a sealed steel-cage match; defending it that same night against Darlock and again six days later against Sao at the War of the Alliances.

name: IWF US Tag Team Championship
epitaph: Held by Death & Destruction as of 13 February 1997, the fed's own newest tag title; a non-title outing against Flying Thunder is previewed for that same night.
